battle.name: 大北方戰爭
battle.brief: 大北方戰爭於1700年在波羅的海東岸展開，俄羅斯與瑞典軍隊在納爾瓦形成初期代表性交鋒。本輪指定的野砲（Field gun，1550年）屬西班牙陸軍野戰炮兵，於1700年前已列入野戰裝備，與步兵協同配置並提供陣地火力支援。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 1700年的交戰雙方是瑞典帝國與俄羅斯沙皇國，戰場在今日愛沙尼亞北部與俄羅斯西北部，核心是納爾瓦河及納爾瓦會戰。瑞典以愛沙尼亞、利沃尼亞及部分英格里亞的沿海據點控制波羅的海東岸；俄軍則由諾夫哥羅德方向集結，向英格里亞與納爾瓦推進。大北方戰爭雖延續至1721年，這裡所記的1700年戰役涵蓋從夏季在芬蘭灣開火、瑞典進攻英格里亞，經納爾瓦渡河與會戰，一直寫到冬季轉向普斯科夫及年底的處置，其後二十餘年的戰果不倒填進這一段。
countriesEn: The belligerents in 1700 were the Swedish Empire and the Tsardom of Russia. The theater lay in what is now northern Estonia and northwestern Russia, with the Narva River and the Battle of Narva at its center. Sweden controlled the eastern Baltic through coastal positions in Estonia, Livonia, and part of Ingria, while Russian forces assembled from the Novgorod direction and advanced toward Ingria and Narva. Although the Great Northern War continued until 1721, the 1700 campaign recorded here begins with the opening fire in the Gulf of Finland that summer, follows Sweden’s invasion of Ingria and the crossing of the Narva, and continues through the winter turn toward Pskov and the year-end disposition of forces. The results of the following two decades are not projected backward into this account.
people: 查理十二世在1700年只有十八歲，1697年即位後已由王室直接掌握軍令；他在納爾瓦決定渡河位置、主力方向與最後的內旋攻勢。瑞典右翼由卡爾·古斯塔夫·雷恩斯基爾德指揮，左翼由奧托·約翰·馮·勒文豪普特指揮，查理本人居中，砲兵與各營依預定位置支援，騎兵團則負責掩護翼側與追擊。俄軍方面的彼得一世親自在場，普列奧布拉任斯基與塞苗諾夫斯基禁衛步兵位於前線；鮑里斯·謝列梅捷夫、伊萬·馬澤帕、阿尼基塔·列普寧、亞當·韋德及法國顧問弗朗索瓦·勒福爾分掌不同指揮工作。俄軍依步兵、哥薩克騎兵與火砲分置營地各段，人數雖多，命令卻須跨越數公里營地傳遞，中央與翼側的反應時間因而不一致。
peopleEn: Charles XII was only eighteen in 1700 and had already taken personal control of royal military command since his accession in 1697. At Narva he chose the crossing point, the direction of the main body, and the final inward wheel of the Swedish line. Carl Gustaf Rehnskiöld commanded the right wing, Otto Johan von Lewenhaupt commanded the left, and Charles held the center, with artillery and battalions supporting according to a prepared plan while cavalry regiments protected the flanks and pursued fugitives. Peter I was present on the Russian side, with the Preobrazhensky and Semyonovsky Guards among the troops in the forward line. Boris Sheremetev, Ivan Mazepa, Anikita Repnin, Adam Veide, and the French adviser François Le Fort shared the Russian command and staff duties. Russian infantry, Cossack cavalry, and artillery occupied separate sectors of a camp several kilometers long, so orders had to cross considerable distance before local movements could be coordinated.
kits: 瑞典步兵以瑞典 Musket m/1670 燧石步槍配刺刀為骨干，騎兵使用 Pistol m/1690 燧石手槍、卡賓槍與軍刀；俄軍步兵使用十七世紀末已列裝的 1695 式燧石步槍，部分營仍保留長矛，並配置火槍、斧與刺刀。雙方野戰砲包括六磅與十二磅口徑，發射實心球及霰彈；納爾瓦之戰時，瑞典隨軍野戰砲約十六門，俄軍營中約六十門。步兵把紙包定裝槍彈分裝於彈匣盒，預備彈藥隨營及車隊保管；砲彈、火藥與砲車分載，轉向或渡河時必須重新編隊。瑞典遠征軍靠黑麵包、鹹肉和馬匹飼料維持行軍，較小的車隊使其能迅速展開；俄軍糧秣與營具更多，卻拉長了營地，也增加了後方車列的脆弱性。
kitsEn: The Swedish infantry was armed principally with the Swedish Musket m/1670 flintlock musket and socket bayonets, while the cavalry carried Pistol m/1690 flintlock pistols, carbines, and sabres. Russian infantry used Model 1695 flintlock muskets already in service late in the seventeenth century; some units retained pikes alongside muskets, axes, and bayonets. Field artillery on both sides included six- and twelve-pounder pieces firing solid shot and canister. At Narva the Swedes brought about sixteen field guns, compared with roughly sixty in the Russian camp. Infantry paper-wrapped ready cartridges were carried in cartridge boxes, with reserve ammunition kept with the units and baggage trains. Artillery shot, powder, and guns traveled separately, requiring formations to be reorganized during a turn or river crossing. The Swedish expedition subsisted on black bread, salt meat, and animal fodder, and its smaller wagon train could deploy rapidly. The Russians carried more provisions and camp equipment, but the longer encampment also made their rear baggage trains more exposed.
tactics: 會戰當日，查理沒有正面攻擊受納爾瓦河與木柵掩護的俄軍營地。他把步兵分成兩縱隊，沿河向上游移動，在俄營北側約四公里的一處可涉渡點渡河；俄軍騎兵前來阻止，瑞典步兵則在推進中以齊射和固守縱隊限制其接近。渡河後，瑞典軍展開成兩道相接的步兵線，右翼靠近俄軍，左翼掩護外側，砲兵置於各線後方，騎兵分列兩翼。俄軍中央主力向前壓上，兩翼則企圖沿森林與道路向瑞典縱隊側後移動；分散 command 使正面與側翼之間的連續性變長。查理見俄軍中央突出後，命右翼向內旋轉，攻擊中央與其相鄰各段；俄軍正面首先失去縱深，後方營門與通道隨即暴露，瑞典左翼及中央由缺口進入營地。俄軍各部轉向納爾瓦河不同渡口，部分人得以越過，部分被截在河岸與營區之間。瑞典奪得俄軍火砲、火藥、輜重和軍旗，並向脫逃者追出一段。天黑、河道缺乏渡河器材及俄軍各部尚未完全散去，使查理沒有把整支追兵投入黑暗中的追擊。
tacticsEn: On the day of the battle Charles did not attack the Russian camp directly, since the Narva River and its palisades protected the principal position. He divided the infantry into two columns and moved upstream to a ford roughly four kilometers north of the Russian camp. Russian cavalry came forward to contest the crossing, but Swedish volleys and compact columns held them at a distance. After crossing, the Swedes formed two connected infantry lines, with the right wing nearest the Russians, the left protecting the outer flank, artillery behind the lines, and cavalry on both sides. The Russian center pressed forward while its wings attempted to move around the Swedish columns through the woods and roads, stretching the continuity between front and flanks. Seeing the Russian center exposed, Charles ordered the right wing to wheel inward against the center and adjoining sectors. The Russian front first lost its support and depth, exposing the entrances and lanes behind the camp; the Swedish left and center then entered through the opening. Russian formations turned toward different crossings of the Narva. Some crossed successfully, while others were caught between the river and the camp. The Swedes captured Russian guns, powder, baggage, and standards and pursued the fugitives for some distance. Darkness, the lack of boats for crossing the river, and Russian formations that had not yet dispersed prevented Charles from committing the entire pursuit force to a night chase.
data: 時間與數字能校準這場戰役，但不能把不同史料硬說成同一份精確名冊。按俄羅斯當時使用的儒略曆，交戰日是1700年11月20日；瑞典史料常記11月19日，換算格里曆則為11月30日。下午約兩時半，瑞典開始渡過納爾瓦；約五時，內旋攻勢已使俄軍中央崩解，天黑前營地被奪。瑞典野戰軍通常估為約一萬三千人，常見史料把作戰主力拆為約八千步兵與二千騎兵，並配十六門野戰砲；俄軍常見估計為三萬至四萬人，約有六十門砲，雙方數字都應視為當時估算而非點名冊。俄軍營位於納爾瓦東岸並沿河延伸數公里，瑞典渡點在營地北側約四公里；納爾瓦至普斯科夫的直線距離約二百二十公里，實際行軍路更長，冬季車列使每日行程受到牽制。死傷資料尤其不一致：陣亡者、河中喪生者、營破後被俘者與逃回者分屬不同統計，因此本文不列未經一致的精確傷亡數字。
dataEn: Dates and figures help anchor the battle, although they cannot be presented as if every source used the same precise roster. By the Julian calendar then used in Russia, the battle was fought on 20 November 1700; Swedish records often give 19 November, while the Gregorian equivalent is 30 November. The Swedish crossing began at about half past two in the afternoon. By roughly five o’clock, the inward wheel had broken the Russian center, and the camp was taken before dark. The Swedish field army is commonly estimated at about 13,000 men, with frequent breakdowns giving approximately 8,000 infantry and 2,000 cavalry, together with sixteen field guns. Russian strength is often given as 30,000 to 40,000 men with about sixty guns, and all these figures should be treated as contemporary estimates rather than audited muster rolls. The Russian camp stood on the east bank of the Narva and extended for several kilometers along the river; the Swedish crossing was about four kilometers north of it. The straight-line distance from Narva to Pskov is approximately 220 kilometers, and the actual marching route was longer, with winter baggage and artillery limiting the distance covered each day. Casualty figures are especially inconsistent because records counted men killed in combat, drowned in the river, captured after the camp fell, or able to escape. No exact casualty number is therefore given here without agreement among the sources.
cause: 彼得一世自1690年代整編軍隊、整頓火砲與後勤，並把取得波羅的海出海通道列為長期目標；俄國在英格里亞與芬蘭灣沿岸集結兵力，使這一目標和瑞典的波羅的海安全直接相撞。1700年夏，查理十二世在里加集結主力，向東北越過道加瓦河，沿利沃尼亞北部前進，以陸軍與艦隊包圍俄方控制的納爾瓦；彼得得知後，率諾夫哥羅德方向的援軍北上。查理若留營等待援軍，攻城器械與補給線便會受威脅，因此把野戰主力移出營地迎戰。瑞典的即時目標是鞏固英格里亞、打開通往普斯科夫的道路，並迫使俄方承認其在波羅的海的既有優勢；俄軍則要保住普斯科夫、解除納爾瓦之圍並摧毀入侵主力。
causeEn: Peter I had reorganized the army, artillery, and logistics throughout the 1690s and made access to the Baltic a long-term Russian objective. The concentration of Russian forces in Ingria and along the Gulf of Finland brought that objective directly into collision with Sweden’s security on the Baltic. In the summer of 1700 Charles XII assembled his main army at Riga, moved northeast across the Daugava, and advanced through northern Livonia. He surrounded Russian-held Narva with both land forces and the fleet, after which Peter marched north with a relief army from the Novgorod direction. Had Charles remained before the city while the relief army approached, his siege equipment and supply line would have been exposed; he therefore moved the field army out to meet it. Sweden’s immediate aims were to secure Ingria, open the road toward Pskov, and force Russia to accept Swedish predominance on the Baltic. The Russian objectives were to preserve Pskov, relieve Narva, and destroy the invading field force.
impact: 入夜時，納爾瓦俄軍的野戰主力已失去原有營地與大部分火砲，裝載火藥、帳篷、車輛和軍旗的營具落入瑞典控制；彼得本人離開戰場並在北方重新聚集可用兵力。俄軍並非全數在河岸被消滅，部分單位完整或零散退回，也有隊伍被封在營內後被迫投降，因此戰果應寫成野戰軍崩解與大量損失，而不是全軍被殺。瑞典雖然守住渡口和營地，仍受夜色、河流與缺乏船隻限制，不能立即渡河追滅殘部；其本身的陣亡、負傷與後勤損失也真實存在，只是規模較小。會戰後數日，納爾瓦要塞落入瑞典控制；十一月底，查理把主力轉向普斯科夫並開始冬季圍城。俄軍利用既有城牆與城防工事抵擋瑞典攻擊，瑞典的圍城炮兵不足以迅速破城；俄軍又以小隊襲擊北面的運輸線，使查理的冬季後勤比會戰本身更棘手。
impactEn: By nightfall the Russian field army at Narva had lost its original camp and most of its artillery, while the camp equipment carrying powder, tents, wagons, and standards fell into Swedish hands. Peter left the battlefield and gathered usable forces again to the north. The Russians were not all destroyed at the riverbank: some units withdrew intact or in fragments, while others were trapped in the camp and compelled to surrender. The result should therefore be described as the collapse of the field army and heavy losses, not the annihilation of every soldier. The Swedes held the crossing and camp, yet darkness, the river, and a shortage of boats prevented an immediate crossing in pursuit of the remnants. Swedish killed, wounded, and logistical losses were real, although on a smaller scale. Within days Narva passed under Swedish control, and late in November Charles moved the main army toward Pskov and began the winter siege. The Russians used the existing walls and defenses to resist Swedish attacks, while Charles lacked enough siege artillery to breach the city quickly. Russian detachments also raided the transport route to the north, making winter supply more difficult than the battle itself.
result: 1700年年底，瑞典握有納爾瓦與英格里亞的戰果，查理十二世在波羅的海東岸仍握主動；俄軍則失去大批野戰裝備與火炮，普斯科夫及通往諾夫哥羅德的內陸地帶仍握在俄國手中。普斯科夫圍城沒有成功，查理必須把計畫轉向南方；他準備讓勒文豪普特率援軍與較重的攻城器材由拉多加南下，卻也因北面距離拉長而暴露補給線。這一安排把1700年的單日勝利轉成1701年必須處理的護送與攻城問題。就1700年本身而言，結果不是俄國退出波羅的海，也不是瑞典奪得普斯科夫，而是瑞典獲得納爾瓦、俄軍在納爾瓦的野戰編制被摧毀、雙方在英格里亞的下一個目標轉為攻城與補給；戰爭因此帶著一場明確的野戰勝負進入下一年。
resultEn: By the end of 1700 Sweden held Narva and the gains made in Ingria, and Charles XII still held the initiative on the eastern Baltic. The Russians had lost a substantial part of their field equipment and artillery, but Pskov and the interior approaches from Novgorod remained in Russian hands. The siege of Pskov had not succeeded, forcing Charles to redirect his plans southward. He prepared to send Lewenhaupt with reinforcements and heavier siege matériel from Ladoga, although the longer northern distance exposed the supply route. The arrangement turned the single-day victory of 1700 into the escort and siege problems that had to be handled in 1701. For 1700 itself, the result was neither a Russian withdrawal from the Baltic nor a Swedish capture of Pskov. Sweden had gained Narva, the Russian field formation at Narva had been shattered, and the next contest in Ingria centered on siegecraft and supply. The war entered the following year with a clear field-battle result already established.
